(# One DRLD per-recipe flowchart (tikz/metis_<recipe>.tex), rendered by generate_drld.py with `chart` set
   to a FlowChart. The skeleton comes from the recipe: the observing templates when the recipe declares
   them, the raw input(s), the calibrations on the left, the products on the right, the frame and label.
   The step column comes from `Recipe._steps` where declared, else a single placeholder step, because the
   algorithm is prose. Styles: tikz/recipe_config.tex. #)
%% Flowchart of (* chart.recipe *), generated by metisp/drld/generate_drld.py -- do not edit
(% for finding in chart.findings %)
% FINDING: (* finding *)
(% endfor %)
\input{black_style}
\input{recipe_config}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  [x=1cm,
  y=-1cm,
  align=center,
  node distance=2cm and 3.5cm]
  \sffamily
(% if chart.templates %)
  \node (template) [template] {%
    (* chart.templates|map('tpl')|join('\\\\\n    ') *)};
  \pic (start)[below=0.75cm of template]{start};
(% else %)
  \pic (start){start};
(% endif %)
  \node (input) [below=0.75cm of start-m, input] {%
    (* chart.raw_inputs|join('\\\\\n    or ') *)};

  %% algorithm steps
(% for step in chart.steps %)
(% if loop.first %)
  \node (step_(* step.key *)) [below=(* chart.first_step_gap *)cm of input, (* step.style *)]{%
(% else %)
  \node (step_(* step.key *)) [below=(* step.gap *)cm of step_(* loop.previtem.key *), (* step.style *)]{%
(% endif %)
    (* step.label *)};
(% endfor %)
  \pic (stop) [below=(* chart.stop_gap *)cm of step_(* chart.steps[-1].key *)] {stop};

(% if chart.templates %)
  \draw [connection_arrow] (template) -- (input);
(% else %)
  \draw [connection_arrow] (start-m) -- (input);
(% endif %)
  \draw [connection_arrow] (input) -- (step_(* chart.steps[0].key *));
(% for step in chart.steps %)
(% if not loop.first %)
  \draw [connection_arrow] (step_(* loop.previtem.key *)) -- (step_(* step.key *));
(% endif %)
(% endfor %)
  \draw [connection_arrow] (step_(* chart.steps[-1].key *)) -- (stop-t);

  %% calibration inputs, attached above the step that consumes them
(% for c in chart.calibrations %)
  \node (connect_(* c.key *)) [connection] at ($((* c.above *))!(* c.fraction *)!(step_(* c.step *))$) {};
  \node ((* c.key *)) [left=of connect_(* c.key *), (* c.style *)] {(* c.reference *)};
  \draw [connection_arrow(% if c.optional %), dashed(% endif %)] ((* c.key *)) -- (connect_(* c.key *));
(% endfor %)

  %% products
(% for p in chart.products %)
  \node (connect_(* p.key *)) [connection] at ($(step_(* chart.steps[-1].key *))!(* p.fraction *)!(stop-t)$) {};
  \node ((* p.key *)) [right=of connect_(* p.key *), (* p.style *)] {(* p.reference *)};
  \draw [connection_arrow] (connect_(* p.key *)) -- ((* p.key *));
(% endfor %)

  \draw [frame] ($(input)!0.1!(step_(* chart.steps[0].key *)) - (2.85,0)$) rectangle
  ($(step_(* chart.steps[-1].key *))!0.75!(stop-t) + (2.85,0)$);
  \node [framecolor, anchor=north west] at
  ($(input)!0.1!(step_(* chart.steps[0].key *)) - (2.85,0)$){%
    \REC{(* chart.recipe *)}};
\end{tikzpicture}
\input{normal_style}
